repos_data.description: The tools your AI needs to make your games. Turn prompts into production-ready game assets — animated characters with their weapons attached, seamless textures, terrain, VFX, HUDs — and playable game kits Unity, Godot, Unreal or Three.js can load.
PicoBerry MCP server — an AI 3D workspace for games, VR, and beyond. Generate, remesh, texture, and animate 3D assets from any MCP client. Multi-engine, one API.
